verdict.rationale: Kling documents image-to-video generation, video-input generation, and an MVL framework that treats images and video as input modalities, so creators can supply reference media to drive new footage. Nothing documents transferring the visual style of a reference onto new content; the evidence shows reference inputs, not style consistency across new shots. missing for 10: explicit style-transfer/style-reference feature documentation, any detail on how video references shape output style, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can point at a reference video or image and generate new footage in that style

citations.quote: Kling AI specializes in text-to-video, image-to-video, and text-to-image generation
Video Generation | std, per second, with video input, no audio
Multi-modal Visual Language (MVL) framework treating text, image, video, and audio as equal input modalities
